minutes.summary: Most of the meeting went to the draft earth removal and fill bylaw: volume thresholds, permit duration, hours, closure plans and enforcement. Items were tabled or scheduled for later meetings.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board tabled the draft earth removal and fill bylaw and its rules and regulations to the next meeting, with no vote taken.
Earth removal was scheduled for September 9; the board called the bylaw its priority for Town Meeting.
The board reached consensus that a new economic development committee will set its own goals, with its membership to be discussed next time.
Master plan discussion was deferred until the board hears about the grant; a member did not want an RFP for a plan without an implementation part.
The board will post and advertise its vacancy and ask the town manager about a joint meeting with the selectmen.

why_it_matters: The earth removal bylaw sets permit rules, hours, closure plans and enforcement for gravel and fill operations, and it is meant to go to Town Meeting, where residents would be asked to vote on it.
A master plan consultant RFP and a new economic development committee could bring future spending requests, and the board has not yet settled the plan's scope or the committee's membership.
watch_next: August 26: economic development, the stone farm hearing and solar are on the Planning Board agenda.
September 9: the earth removal bylaw and rules and regulations return to the board.
